title: Prices registry
description: data/registry/prices.json: dated prices per model and route (DATA-PIPELINE §4). Base route = the maker's API; base price = the standard list price in force on as_of (retired model: its last list price; never applied: the price charged).

as_of.description: The pinned date of the build's base prices.

classes.description: Price per class, in currency per `per` (null = not offered / not stated).

configurations.description: The configurations this price applies to, when the maker prices them differently (Qwen3-8B thinking output 2.1 vs non-thinking 0.7, 23 Oct 2026); absent = every configuration of the model. Entries of one model, route and kind that overlap in time must not share a configuration.

factor.description: For batch / flex / promotion entries: the multiplier of the standard price, when given that way.

base.description: Marks the base price when it is not the standard list price in force on as_of: a retired model's last list price, or the price actually charged when the standard price never applied (Gemini 3.7 Flash $0.75, the maintainer, 21 Oct). At most one base per model (per configuration, for entries with `configurations`).

threshold_input_tokens.description: Per-request input tokens above which the tier applies.

classes.description: Price per class, in currency per `per` (null = not offered / not stated).

list_after.description: A promotion with a stated end that states the list price after it ('$0.75 through December 31, 2026. $1.50 starting January 1, 2027'): that list price and its start, cited by the promotion's own evidence. base_price uses it when no standard price is in force on as_of (promotions are never a base; coordinator 26 Oct).
